title: In this world, every lie you tell erases a memory forever
formula: 'In this world' rule -> world tour (Linda's meatloaf, the boss and doors) -> you almost never lie (3 lies, can't whistle) -> goal + stake (meet Maya's parents; a lie could erase her) -> opponent (her dad tests every boyfriend) -> setback 1 (casserole: 'I love it!', forks gone) -> setback 2 (Dad's joke: 'Hilarious.', your name gone) -> stakes peak (one more could be Maya) -> big test ('Do you love my daughter?') -> tension stretch (one second, two, three) -> turn: no pop, the rule proves it's true -> Dad shakes your hand -> punch: honest 'Absolutely not' to more casserole -> loop: you'll remember it forever.
loop: Line 1: every lie erases a memory forever. Last: the one thing you'll remember forever is the casserole.

voiceNotes.dad: Brian (ElevenLabs premade): deep older man, the dad who tests every boyfriend
voiceNotes.mom: Laura (ElevenLabs premade): bright, sweet, hopeful mom

facts: Fiction: one changed rule, every spoken lie erases one random memory forever. Never explained.
Comic exaggeration: Linda and the meatloaf, the boss and doors, the hissing casserole, forgetting forks and your own name.

lines.narration: In this world, every lie you tell erases a memory *forever*.
lines.scene: Cold open on the first word, a bus stop on a sunny street: a man in a suit grins and tells the woman beside him something; a glowing memory bubble (his birthday cake inside it) rises out of his head and pops on 'forever'.
lines.camera: MS two-shot, tilt up with the bubble, hold on the pop
lines.gag: A memory bubble pops out of a liar's head

lines.narration: And you never get to *pick* which one.
lines.scene: The same man blinks, looks down at the bus ticket in his hand like he has never seen one, and tries to eat it.
lines.camera: CU on the man's blank face and the ticket
lines.gag: He tries to eat his bus ticket

lines.narration: You see, your neighbour Linda told her husband she loved his meatloaf. For *30 years*.
lines.spoken: You see, your neighbour Linda told her husband she loved his meatloaf. For THIRTY years.
lines.scene: Linda's kitchen: Linda, curlers and a flowered apron, beaming at a huge grey meatloaf; behind her a wall of 30 framed photos of the same meatloaf, one per year.
lines.camera: MS on Linda and the meatloaf, pull back to reveal the photo wall on '30 years'
lines.gag: A wall of 30 framed meatloaf photos

lines.narration: Now she introduces herself to him every *morning*.
lines.scene: Linda at the breakfast table shaking her husband's hand politely, both in bathrobes; he wears a name tag 'HUSBAND'.
lines.camera: MCU two-shot across the table
lines.gag: Linda shakes her own husband's hand

lines.narration: Your boss said "great idea" in so many meetings, he forgot how *doors* work.
lines.spoken: Your boss said "great idea" in so many meetings, he forgot how DOORS work.
lines.scene: Office glass door marked PULL: your boss, tie and coffee mug, pushing it over and over, his face squashed on the glass.
lines.camera: MCU through the glass from the other side, his face pressed against it on 'doors'
lines.gag: The boss's face squashed against a PULL door

lines.narration: So you almost never lie. You've told 3 lies in your whole life, and you still can't *whistle*.
lines.scene: Your bathroom mirror: you puckered up, trying to whistle; only air comes out.
lines.camera: MCU on you in the mirror
lines.spoken: So you almost never lie. You've told three lies in your whole life, and you still can't whistle.

lines.narration: And tonight, that matters. You're meeting your girlfriend Maya's *parents*.
lines.scene: Their front porch at dusk: you in a tucked-in shirt holding flowers, Maya beside you squeezing your hand; the door swings open on her parents.
lines.camera: MS on the porch, push in as the door opens
lines.gag: The door opens on both parents at once

lines.narration: One lie at that table, and the memory you lose could be *her*.
lines.scene: A memory bubble with Maya's smiling face in it wobbles over your head, about to pop; it holds.
lines.camera: CU on the bubble over your worried face
lines.gag: Maya's face in a trembling bubble

lines.narration: Her dad tests every boyfriend with questions. The last one forgot how to *drive*.
lines.scene: Her dad at the head of the dinner table, cracking his knuckles; quick cut to the window: a young guy outside pushing his car down the street by hand.
lines.camera: MCU on Dad, hard cut to the window on 'drive'
lines.gag: The last boyfriend pushes his car home

lines.narration: "Let's see how long YOU *last*."
lines.scene: Dad leaning over the roast chicken toward you, grinning, fork pointed at you.
lines.camera: Low-angle MCU on Dad
lines.gag: Dad points his fork at you
lines.speaker: dad

lines.narration: Then her mom brings out the casserole. It's grey. It wobbles. It *hisses*.
lines.scene: Mom sets down a grey wobbling casserole; it jiggles, and a puff of steam hisses out like a cat.
lines.camera: Insert on the casserole landing, hold for the hiss

lines.narration: "Do you *like* it?"
lines.scene: Mom, oven mitts on, beaming at you, hands clasped.
lines.camera: MCU on Mom
lines.speaker: mom

lines.narration: You panic. "I *love* it!"
lines.scene: You with a spoonful halfway to your mouth, a huge fake smile, sweat drop.
lines.camera: CU on you

lines.narration: *Pop*. You forget how forks *work*.
lines.scene: A bubble with a fork in it pops over your head. You look at your fork, then hold it to your ear like a phone.
lines.camera: Tilt up with the bubble, hard cut to you holding the fork to your ear
lines.spoken: Pop. You forget how forks work.

lines.narration: So you eat the casserole with your *hands*. Maya stares at you.
lines.scene: You scooping grey casserole with your bare hand; Maya beside you, frozen mid-bite.
lines.camera: Two-shot of you and Maya

lines.narration: Then her dad tells a *joke*.
lines.scene: Dad drumming the table, laughing at his own joke before the punchline.
lines.camera: MCU on Dad
lines.gag: Dad laughs at his own joke

lines.narration: "What do you call a fish with no eyes? A *fsh*."
lines.scene: Dad drumming the table, laughing at his own joke before the punchline.
lines.camera: MCU on Dad
lines.gag: Dad laughs at his own joke
lines.speaker: dad
lines.spoken: "What do you call a fish with no eyes? A... fsh."

lines.narration: "Funny, *right*?"
lines.scene: Dad leaning in, eyebrows up, waiting.
lines.camera: CU on Dad
lines.speaker: dad

lines.narration: "*Hilarious*." Pop. Now you've forgotten your own *name*.
lines.scene: You say it; a bubble with your driver's licence in it pops. You pull out your wallet and read your licence, squinting.
lines.camera: CU on you, insert on the licence
lines.gag: You read your own name off your licence
lines.spoken: "Hilarious." Pop. Now you've forgotten your own name.

lines.narration: Two lies, two memories gone. One more, and it could be *Maya*.
lines.scene: Maya's bubble over your head trembling harder; you grip the table.
lines.camera: Slow push-in on you, the bubble wobbling

lines.narration: Then her dad puts down his *fork*.
lines.scene: Dad sets his fork down with a click; everyone turns to you.
lines.camera: MCU on Dad, cut to the whole table turning
lines.gag: Every head at the table turns

lines.narration: "Do you love my *daughter*?"
lines.scene: Dad leaning in, dead serious; behind him Mom and Maya turn to you.
lines.camera: MCU on Dad, cut to the whole table turning
lines.gag: Every head at the table turns
lines.speaker: dad

lines.narration: The whole table goes quiet. Even the casserole stops *hissing*.
lines.scene: Silence: Mom frozen, Maya holding her breath, the casserole's steam stops mid-puff.
lines.camera: Slow pan across the frozen table

lines.narration: You've never said it out loud. And if it's not true, you'll forget *her*.
lines.scene: You looking at Maya; her bubble over your head, trembling.
lines.camera: CU on you, Maya soft behind

lines.narration: You close your eyes, and say it. "*Yes*."
lines.scene: Eyes shut, you say it.
lines.camera: ECU on your face

lines.narration: You wait for the pop. One second. Two. Three... *nothing*.
lines.scene: Everyone stares up at the bubble over your head. It doesn't pop. It glows.
lines.camera: Tilt up to the bubble, hold
lines.gag: The bubble glows instead of popping

lines.narration: Because it's not a lie. And everyone at that table just watched you *prove* it.
lines.scene: Maya's eyes fill with tears and she grabs your hand; Mom clasps her mitts.
lines.camera: Two-shot, push in on Maya

lines.narration: Her dad sits back... and shakes your *hand*.
lines.scene: Dad reaches across the table and shakes your casserole-covered hand, then looks at his own hand.
lines.camera: MS across the table

lines.narration: Then her mom slides over the *casserole*.
lines.scene: Mom pushing the hissing casserole toward you.
lines.camera: MCU on Mom

lines.narration: "*More*?"
lines.scene: Mom smiling, pushing the hissing dish toward you.
lines.camera: MCU on Mom
lines.speaker: mom

lines.narration: You look at it. You look at her. "Absolutely *not*."
lines.scene: You, calm and honest, pushing it back. Dad bursts out laughing.
lines.camera: CU on you, Dad laughing behind

lines.narration: And that casserole? You'll remember it *forever*.
lines.scene: Close on your face, a little haunted, as the casserole hisses at you one last time.
lines.camera: CU on you, the casserole sharp in the foreground
